skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding and distinguishing land transfer mechanisms
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and differentiate various land transfer mechanisms such as land allocation, land leasing, and land recovery.
Understand different types of financial revenues from land and land prices.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding principles and methods of managing land transactions
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the principles, contents, and methods of managing land transactions on the market.
Understand and differentiate various types of land disputes and their resolution processes.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Linking issues of land management and use
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Link theoretical knowledge with practical issues in land management and use.
Identify suitable land policies to explain specific land management situations.
Analyze real-life situations and apply appropriate management methods.
Synthesize various research materials related to land management.
Actively engage in learning, research, and group work.
Choose appropriate research methods and materials to analyze real-life land management situations.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
